g.text: Open a personal race recap — main requirement FR-01
Find runner, category, result and splits
Matching baseline records or no match
DNF; no finish time or finish pace
Prepare timing, pace, ranks and split insights
Rank and split policies: OD-02 / OD-03
No invented finish or DNF label
[A valid finisher or known-DNF recap can be prepared]
Read stored optional metrics and photos for runner / BIB
Combine runner-specific summary and optional data
Recap model; gallery or no-photo state
Opening a recap does not initiate Strava OAuth or require a live Strava request.
Optional connection is a separate runner action (FR-08-FR-11).
Responsibilities describe a proposed design, not verified code classes.
